text: In the (−,+,+,+) signature used throughout this book, the Minkowski metric is η_μν = diag(−1, +1, +1, ___).
explanation: The book uses signature (−,+,+,+): the single time component carries −1 and each of the three spatial components carries +1, so η_μν = diag(−1,+1,+1,+1). The opposite sign on the time direction versus the spatial directions is the source of all the distinctive effects of special relativity.
